findings.title: curl.sh poll loop uses `[ ... ] || [ ... ] && break` without an explicit if guard
findings.problem: Under `set -euo pipefail` the `[ ... ] || [ ... ] && break` chain is correct for breaking but yields a non-zero exit when neither branch matches; it is safe only because `sleep` follows and resets $?. Fragile but not blocking (documentation example).
findings.fix: Use an explicit guard: `if [ "$status" = succeeded ] || [ "$status" = failed ]; then break; fi`.
